body: DURABILITY DISPOSITION: V2 is now flagged needs-bead. Do not fold it into D2 V8 or propose V9 while the required Scout review is outstanding. After V8 lands, create one narrow documentation amendment that integrates only the independently reviewed acquisition-sequence refinements into the plan and notes, with fresh reviewers and no runtime authority. Until then, the pinned topic summary and V2 post are the durable coordination record.
